cards.name: form_valid
cards.spec: form_valid(self, form) creates the sale by calling create_sale(customer, number, date), imported from sales.services, with form.cleaned_data customer, number and date. create_sale raises ValueError only when the customer is not active. If it raises, add the text to the form with form.add_error(None, str(e)) and return self.form_invalid(form), so the form is shown again with status 200 and no Sale is created. On success redirect to sales:list. Do not use the messages framework.
